central_question: Can the frozen discovery matcher discriminate between true cross-domain relationships and matched null controls at a rate significantly above chance?

frozen_matcher.amendment_1_compliance: matcher is imported and called through public interface; not edited, modified, or calibrated

L4_semantic.model: N/A (no embedding model in frozen production matcher)

control_construction.algorithm: for each gold[i]: shuffled_bridge = gold[(i + 10) % 20].bridge; fallback offset = 7 if collision
control_construction.quality_audit: required (Amendment 9). If any null violates matching properties: INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_NULL

candidate_generation.scoring: frozen _bridge_matches() returns True/False. No separate scoring layer.

primary_discrimination_metric.name: delta_TPR_FPR
primary_discrimination_metric.success_condition: Δ ≥ 0.20 AND lower bound of 95% CI for Δ > 0

statistical_procedure.ties_policy: ties produce Δ=0, CI lower bound ≤ 0, fails success condition

sample_size.multiplicity: single primary comparison, no correction needed

decision_rule.NOT_DISCRIMINATIVE_handling: result preserved, no rescue, no synonym addition, no threshold change, no hard case removal, no null alteration, no rerun, no 'promising' label, discovery claims remain BLOCKED

dxp005_resumption_conditions: P46 served-instrument verification satisfied (ZAI CLI response includes model AND provider fields)

adversarial_attack_matrix.control_contamination: fixed offset (10), fallback (7), quality audit required
adversarial_attack_matrix.candidate_encoding: candidate is bridge string only, no metadata
adversarial_attack_matrix.ordering_leak: matcher receives one pair at a time, no order visibility
adversarial_attack_matrix.scorer_info_advantage: scorer IS matcher, no separate scoring layer
adversarial_attack_matrix.null_contamination: shuffled bridge from different domain pair, flagged if accidentally valid
adversarial_attack_matrix.provider_leak: frozen matcher is pure string matching, no LLM calls
adversarial_attack_matrix.threshold_shopping: threshold 0.20 preregistered BEFORE results, not data-derived
adversarial_attack_matrix.direct_invocation_bypass: harness IS direct invocation, epistemic gate blocks ungated consumers
adversarial_attack_matrix.future_input_modification: Phase 7 freeze gate maintains SHA-256 hashes, detects modifications
